name: 3D free-stream flow
description: Box, grid, species/mixture and a free-stream inflow for a 3D case
body: mixture         air N2 O2 vstream 1000.0 0 0 temp 300.0

name: 2D flow
body: mixture         air N2 O2 vstream 1000.0 0 0 temp 300.0

name: Collisions (VSS)
description: Enable VSS collisions for the 'air' mixture

name: Read surface + collision model
description: Read an explicit surface and assign a diffuse collision model

name: Ablation (implicit surface)
description: Convert a read surface to an implicit ablating surface

name: Dump image
description: Render particles + surfaces to a PNG image sequence
body: dump            img image all 100 image.*.ppm type type &

name: Dump particles
description: Write per-particle attributes to a dump file
body: dump            part particle all 100 dump.*.txt id type x y z vx vy vz

name: Time-averaged grid stats
description: compute + fix ave/time to accumulate grid flow properties
body: compute         g grid all species n u v w
dump            grid grid all 1000 grid.*.txt id f_avg[*]

name: Thermo output
description: Standard thermodynamic output cadence and columns
body: stats_style     step cpu np nattempt ncoll nscoll nscheck

name: Run
description: Advance the simulation a number of timesteps
